subject: Audit log evidence handoff — packaging checklist & export formats for SIG/CAIQ review
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya@acmepharma.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-team@acmepharma.com
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:18 -0700
Subject: Audit log exports for SIG/CAIQ — formats & delivery window

Hi team,

Following up from our security intake: Acme's external audit kicked off and the assessment team is asking for admin activity / audit log evidence to satisfy SIG and CAIQ controls. They specifically need:
- a sample of admin activity (create/delete/role changes, IAM events) covering a 30-day window;
- an export manifest describing schemas and retention policy;
- delivery in a machine-readable format (JSONL/CSV) and manifest-level hashes for chain-of-custody.

Can you confirm what formats Redwood can provide, whether we can include full request/response metadata (headers, request IDs) or trimmed records, and the expected lead time for a full bundle? Also please advise on redaction options for user PII and recommended KMS signing for the bundle.

We prefer S3 signed-URL handoff or a secure Google Drive link with limited time access.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Reddy
Security Manager — Acme Pharma

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@acmepharma.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, audit-team@acmepharma.com
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 12:03:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log exports for SIG/CAIQ — formats & delivery window

Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. High level options we can provide immediately for the 30-day sample and the manifest:

1) JSONL full-record export (recommended for SIG): includes timestamp (ISO8601), actor_id, action, target_resource, request_id, request_metadata (truncated headers), and outcome. Each record is one event.

2) CSV summary (for quick ingestion): flattened rows with a mapping document. Good for operational reviewers but loses nested metadata.

3) Parquet archive (for large buckets): compressed, schema-evolution friendly; good if you want to run queries in BigQuery/Athena.

Redaction: we can apply field-level masking for display_name/email (replace with uid:%HASH% or hash(email) depending on your preference). SOC-2 guidance: we include hashed actor_ids and provide a mapping file to named users under an NDA.

Chain-of-custody: we can provide an evidence_manifest.csv with SHA256 checksums for each exported file plus a signed envelope (we use customer KMS signing or Redwood HSM if customer key isn't available).

Delivery: for the 30-day sample we can turn around within 48 hours. For a full bundle (90-365 days) expect 3–5 business days depending on size and whether you want on-prem packaging.

Attached: admin_activity_sample.jsonl (30 events), evidence_manifest_v1.csv, and a one-page packaging_instructions.pdf.

Let us know if S3 signed URLs are preferred (we will generate one with a 7-day expiry) or if you want an encrypted Drive folder.

Regards,

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 14:22:45 -07:00
Subject: Internal: packaging choices & PII mapping for Acme bundle

Ben / Karthik — quick thread to align on what we hand off and the internal approvals required. Points below: 

- Default export: JSONL compressed + evidence_manifest.csv + manifest signature. Provide both hashed_actor map (for auditors under NDA) and a redacted view.
- If Acme requests full email addresses, we need a documented request from their legal/security owner and an entry in our disclosure log. Avoid sending raw PII unless explicitly approved.
- For KMS: offer them a customer-managed KMS key (preferred). If not, sign with Redwood HSM and include verification steps for auditors.
- Storage: use a dedicated S3 bucket per-customer with lifecycle policy; for short retention samples we can retain for 30 days after handoff.
- Audit trail capture: include a 'packaged_by' admin_activity record showing who prepared the bundle with a timestamp and job-id.

Action items:
- Ben: confirm that the packaging job will include truncated request headers (we currently drop auth tokens but keep request_id, ip_cidr range).
- Karthik: prepare the SHA256 sign-off script and the S3 signed URL workflow (7-day default expiry).

Looping Marissa for procurement/contract signoff on the NDA mapping file approach.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@acmepharma.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, audit-team@acmepharma.com
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log exports for SIG/CAIQ — formats & delivery window

Priya —

Thanks — we can proceed with the JSONL sample and manifest. Summary of what you'll receive:
- admin_activity_sample.jsonl (30-day window, 30 sample events)
- evidence_manifest_v1.csv (file list + SHA256 + file_size_bytes + schema_version)
- packaging_instructions.pdf (how to verify checksums + contact matrix)

Delivery: we'll upload to an S3 bucket and share a signed URL valid for 7 days by EOD today. If Acme requires customer KMS signing, please confirm and share the key ARN; otherwise we'll sign with Redwood HSM and provide verification instructions.

PII: we will hash actor emails by default. If you need the mapping, please provide an NDA contact/email and we will route the mapping file through legal.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference

P.S. Link to the temp bundle (internal): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/acmepharma/20250518-bundle (signed URL will be sent separately)
